Plan narrative pins --max-children, timeout values, and version but does not name the result-extraction subcommand

findings.finding: The plan's status taxonomy (killed/survived/no-tests/timeout/incomplete/not-checked) is load-bearing for the advisory/ratchet/strict rules and ACs, but the plan never names the exact mutmut command the driver uses to extract per-mutant status. The plan's own recorded probe found that `export-cicd-stats` OMITS `not-checked` and `caught-by-type-check`, so the obvious extraction command silently drops two consumed statuses.
findings.location: Plan body 'For each archive the driver synthesizes...' and Primary evidence ('maps exit codes to every consumed status'); ACs on advisory/ratchet/strict status handling

findings.suggested_fix: In the driver description, state that per-mutant status is read from `mutmut results --all true` (not `export-cicd-stats`) and enumerate the full consumed status set, citing the probe finding.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Declare the mutation job's access posture explicitly: state that the reusable mutation workflow inherits NO secrets (Gerrit vote key stays confined to gerrit-verify.yaml), that fork-PR runs execute only untrusted code with no secret exposure, and that the merge-gating verdict is computed from trusted code (folded via vote.needs) — mirroring the sibling reusables.
evidence: Plan: 'Gerrit checks out the exact patchset and includes mutation in vote.needs; the push/PR lane mirrors it.'

_optionality.yml header: 'This workflow takes NO secrets ... the Verified vote key stays confined to gerrit-verify.yaml (never inherited here — the push caller's pull_request trigger includes fork PRs).'
gerrit-verify.yaml vote job: 'the vote decision must never run patchset-controlled code (the vote SSH key is scoped to the cast step's with:)'
OWASP A05 (Security Misconfiguration) / CI supply-chain: mutation runs untrusted PR code that feeds a merge-gating vote.
findings.finding: The mutation gate is the one boundary-crossing surface the plan creates: mutation testing executes change-controlled code (mutated source + the change's own tests) on CI runners, the plan puts it in vote.needs and says 'the push/PR lane mirrors it', and the repo's pull_request trigger includes fork PRs (a lower-trust actor). Every existing sibling reusable workflow (_build-and-test.yml, _optionality.yml) explicitly DECLARES its access posture ('This workflow takes NO secrets... the Verified vote key stays confined to gerrit-verify.yaml, never inherited here — the pull_request trigger includes fork PRs'), and gerrit-verify.yaml's vote job explicitly runs trusted main code so 'the vote decision must never run patchset-controlled code'. The plan does not state the mutation job's secret-inheritance / fork-PR posture, nor that its verdict computation stays on trusted code. The mirrored pattern strongly mitigates, so this is an advisory undeclared-posture note, not a blocking gap.
findings.location: Plan section 'A selector inspects HEAD^..HEAD ...' / 'the push/PR lane mirrors it'; AC 'Workflows use selector-derived per-shard matrix jobs ... push/PR parity'
scenarios: A fork PR opens the mutation job; if the mirrored reusable ever inherited the vote key or org secrets, untrusted code could exfiltrate them.
A patchset that manipulates its own tests to force a green mutation verdict if the verdict decision runs inside the patchset-executing job rather than on trusted main.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a sentence to the workflow section: 'The reusable mutation workflow takes NO secrets and inherits none; the Gerrit Verified vote key stays confined to gerrit-verify.yaml. Fork-PR runs execute only untrusted change code with no secret exposure, and the mutation verdict reaches the vote solely as a folded job conclusion (vote.needs), never by running patchset-controlled decision code.'
